about: Hybrid World Specialist (HWS) is a hybrid car specialist in Johor Bahru, at Taman Bukit Indah in Iskandar Puteri. We work on Toyota, Lexus and Honda hybrids: hybrid battery replacement, hybrid battery reconditioning, hybrid system and inverter faults, and the everyday maintenance every car needs.

For hybrid battery replacement in JB we fit new original/OEM battery sets. They come only as complete assembled units, never as single cells. If your pack can be saved, we can recondition it on our battery rack instead.
We also do aircon service (including aircon system flushing), auto transmission repair, engine rebuilds and general car maintenance, so one workshop can look after the whole car.

faq.q: Which hybrid cars do you work on?
faq.a: Toyota and Lexus hybrids such as the Prius and Prius C, C-HR, Camry Hybrid, Corolla Cross Hybrid, Estima, Alphard and Voxy Hybrid, Lexus CT200h, ES and NX, and Honda hybrids such as the Shuttle Hybrid.

faq.q: Do you replace single cells in a hybrid battery?
faq.a: No. For battery replacement we fit new original/OEM hybrid battery sets, and they are sold only as complete assembled units. If your pack is still worth saving, ask us about reconditioning.

faq.q: How much does a hybrid battery cost?
faq.a: It depends on the model and on what the check finds. WhatsApp us your car model and year and we will tell you the options and the price before any work starts.

faq.q: Where is the workshop and when are you open?
faq.a: No 5, Jalan Indah 16/6, Taman Bukit Indah, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru. We are open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm, and closed on Sunday.

battery.title: Hybrid Battery Replacement JB | New Original Sets | HWS
battery.description: Hybrid battery replacement in JB with new original/OEM battery sets, complete assembled units for Prius, Camry, C-HR, Lexus and Honda hybrids.
battery.intro: Hybrid battery replacement in JB at Hybrid World Specialist means a new original/OEM hybrid battery set, fitted as one complete assembled unit. We never sell single cells. Owners come to us for a Prius hybrid battery in JB, and for Camry, C-HR, Estima, Alphard, Voxy, Lexus and Honda hybrid batteries too.

sections.h2: When a hybrid battery needs replacing
p: A tired hybrid battery usually shows up as a hybrid system warning on the dashboard, the engine running more than it used to, or the car feeling weak when you pull away. These signs can have other causes too, so we check the car before we recommend a new battery.
If the check shows the pack can still be saved, we will tell you, and hybrid battery reconditioning may be the better choice.

sections.h2: New original/OEM battery sets, complete units only
p: We fit new original/OEM hybrid battery sets. They come as complete assembled units, ready to go into the car, never as loose single cells. That keeps the whole pack matched from day one.
You can see brand-new battery units and a part label close-up in our reels on the home page.

The Toyota Prius and Prius C are among the hybrids we see most. The same goes for the Camry Hybrid, C-HR, Corolla Cross Hybrid and the Estima, Alphard and Voxy Hybrid. WhatsApp us your model and year and we will tell you what is possible for your car.

faq.q: Do you sell single hybrid battery cells?
faq.a: No. Our new original/OEM hybrid battery sets are sold only as complete assembled units, never as single cells.

faq.q: Should I replace or recondition my hybrid battery?
faq.a: It depends on the condition of your pack. We check the car first and then tell you whether reconditioning or a new battery set makes more sense.

faq.q: How much is a hybrid battery replacement?
faq.a: The price depends on the car model. WhatsApp us your model and year and we will quote you before any work starts.

recon.title: Hybrid Battery Reconditioning JB | Hybrid World (HWS)
recon.description: Hybrid battery reconditioning in Johor Bahru on our own battery rack, for Toyota Camry, Estima, Alphard, Prius and other hybrids. WhatsApp us.
recon.h1: Hybrid Battery Reconditioning in Johor Bahru
recon.intro: Hybrid battery reconditioning gives your existing hybrid battery pack another chance before you think about a new one. At Hybrid World Specialist in Johor Bahru we recondition packs on our own battery conditioning rack, in a separate battery room inside the workshop.

p: A hybrid battery pack is made of many cells working together. Reconditioning works on your existing pack on a conditioning rack, instead of replacing it.
Not every pack is worth reconditioning. We check it first and tell you honestly whether reconditioning or a new battery set is the better choice.

Packs are connected to our battery conditioning rack, with a laptop alongside, in a room of its own. Our reels show Camry Hybrid, Estima Hybrid and Alphard Hybrid battery sets being reconditioned there.
If your hybrid shows a battery warning, or the engine seems to run more than before, WhatsApp us your model and year. We will tell you what the next step is.

faq.q: Can every hybrid battery be reconditioned?
faq.a: No. We check the pack first. If reconditioning is not the right choice, we will explain why and talk you through a new original/OEM battery set.

faq.q: Which models have you reconditioned?
faq.a: Our reels show Toyota Camry Hybrid, Estima Hybrid and Alphard Hybrid battery sets being reconditioned. Ask us about your own model on WhatsApp.

faq.q: How do I start?
faq.a: Send us a WhatsApp with your car model, year and the warning you see, and we will arrange a check.

inverter.title: Hybrid Inverter Repair JB | Hybrid System Faults | HWS
inverter.description: Hybrid inverter repair and hybrid system fault repair in Johor Bahru for Toyota, Lexus and Honda hybrids. Check first, quote before work.
inverter.h1: Hybrid System & Inverter Repair, Johor Bahru
inverter.intro: Hybrid inverter repair and hybrid system fault repair for Toyota, Lexus and Honda hybrids in Johor Bahru. When the hybrid system warning comes on, we trace the fault first, then explain it and quote before we fix it.

p: The inverter sits between the hybrid battery and the electric motor. It turns the battery's power into the form the motor uses, and back again when the car recharges itself. When it has a fault, the car may show a hybrid system warning or lose electric drive.

sections.h2: Hybrid system warnings we look at
p: A hybrid system warning can come from the battery, the inverter, cooling, wiring or sensors. That is why we check the whole hybrid system before we name the part, so you do not pay for the wrong repair.
WhatsApp us your car model, year and a photo of the dashboard warning. It helps us prepare before you come in.

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with a hybrid system warning?
faq.a: Every case is different. Send us a photo of the warning and your car details on WhatsApp, and we will advise you on the next step.

faq.q: Do you repair inverters on Honda hybrids too?
faq.a: We work on Toyota, Lexus and Honda hybrid systems. WhatsApp us your model and year to check.

faq.q: Will you tell me the price first?
faq.a: Yes. We check the car, explain what we found and give you a quote before we fix it.

toyota.intro: Toyota hybrid repair in Johor Bahru and Lexus hybrid repair in JB, from routine servicing to hybrid battery and hybrid system work. We look after the hybrid parts and the rest of the car too, including steering and suspension.

p: We work on the Toyota Prius and Prius C, C-HR, Camry Hybrid, Corolla Cross Hybrid, and the Estima, Alphard and Voxy Hybrid. The photos below show a Toyota Voxy hybrid service and a Toyota C-HR on our lift.
We also work on Lexus hybrids, including the CT200h, ES and NX. Lexus hybrids share many hybrid parts with Toyota, so the same checks apply.
A hybrid still needs everything a normal car needs: servicing, brakes, steering and suspension. Our photos show steering racks, struts and bushings being replaced in the workshop.
Tell us what you notice, such as noise over bumps or a heavy steering feel, and we will check it.
